name: airimate-one
description: AiriMate One — 单实例单窗口 AI 女友桌宠（AIRI 能力内核 + Mate VRM/动捕动作）

scripts.build:contracts: npm run build -w @airimate/shared && npm run build -w @airimate/security && npm run build -w @airimate/companion-kit
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @airimate/motion-director && npm run build -w @airimate/avatar-stage && npm run build -w @airimate/radial-menu
scripts.build: npm run build:packages:prod && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:prod -w @airimate/desktop
scripts.build:packages:prod: node tools/qa/clean-dist-maps.mjs && npm run build:prod -w @airimate/shared && npm run build:prod -w @airimate/security && npm run build:prod -w @airimate/companion-kit && npm run build:prod -w @airimate/motion-director && npm run build:prod -w @airimate/avatar-stage && npm run build:prod -w @airimate/radial-menu
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:packages && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:desktop
scripts.build:dist: npm run build && node tools/qa/stage-dist.mjs --clean --with-runtime && node tools/qa/scan-dist-payload.mjs && node tools/qa/verify-dist-integrity.mjs
